test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"alone."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Alone"** means without others, without any other person. (अकेला; बिना किसी अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति के) • **Example**: *I live **alone__**.* • This word fits the sentence's context. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage**: In a busy bus station, there is a little girl sitting all __**alone**__ on a bench. She stares at the floor as all the busy travellers rush ______ (2) ______ her. Some of the people are in such a big hurry that they do not ______ (3) ______ her. Other people look at her, but continue running to where they need to go. After some time, a man stops next to the girl. He is very tired after a long day of work, and he just wants to get to his home as quickly as ______ (4) ______ so that he can be with his family. But he cannot just leave this little girl alone. He cannot see her ______ (5) ______ anywhere. The little girl is no older than his own little daughter.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • "Sole" means only or single, but it does not fit grammatically in the sentence. (केवल; सिर्फ़; एकमात्र) • "Just" means only or simply, but it does not fit grammatically in the sentence. (अभी-अभी, हाल ही में, एकदम पहले) • "Unique" means one of a kind, but it does not fit grammatically in the sentence. (जिसके समान दूसरा नहीं, अनन्‍य, अद्वितीय, बेजोड़; अपनी तरह का अकेला, एकल) 43:T118e, The correct answer is **"around."**
